recipe.visualDefinition: A full-body portrait of a mature man standing in a classical stone corridor with textured, pitted walls. The lighting is warm and directional, creating soft shadows. The composition features a mix of organic human presence against rigid, geometric architectural elements, with text blocks placed in the negative space of the background.
coreVisualRelationships: Textured stone background contrasting with smooth fabric
Warm earth tones unified across the environment and skin tones
Horizontal text blocks balancing the verticality of the columns
coreInvariants: Pitted, porous stone texture on all architectural surfaces
High-key white shirt as the primary light reflector
Soft, diffused sunlight entering from the side

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Full-body male figure, centered horizontally, occupying the middle two-thirds of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's white shirt provides the highest contrast point and central anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the subject's face, down the vertical line of the body, then branching to the text blocks on the right and bottom-left.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The stone walls and floor provide ample textured negative space for typographic overlays.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between the shirt and the background shadows.

letterConstructionRules: Irregular, chiseled edges suggesting stone carving
Variable stroke widths with organic tapering
Subtle drop shadows to separate text from textured background
characterSpecificRedesigns: Enlarged initial caps for the primary name
Lower-case sans-serif for secondary title with a horizontal line element
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A rough, chiseled display face paired with a clean, modern sans-serif for contrast.
graphicDevices: Semi-transparent rectangular overlay behind secondary text
Horizontal divider line cutting through the ampersand

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the chiseled, stone-carved feel of the primary text.
Provides a clean, readable contrast for the secondary information.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A full-body shot of a mature man with grey hair and a goatee, wearing a crisp white button-down shirt and dark jeans, standing in a sunlit corridor made of heavily textured Travertine stone. A decorative ceramic urn is visible in the bottom right corner.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply large, chiseled-edge white uppercase text to the right of the subject. Add a semi-transparent grey box in the bottom left containing two lines of lowercase sans-serif white text, separated by a thin horizontal line.

verificationChecks: Stone texture is visible through the semi-transparent box
Text edges appear slightly eroded or hand-carved
Lighting on the subject matches the direction of shadows in the architecture
White shirt is the brightest point in the image

adjustableVariables: Opacity of the text background box
Degree of 'chisel' effect on the display font
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
Exact phrasing of the original text
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the man's pose feels relaxed and integrated into the space
Check that the text does not obscure the subject's face
Verify the stone texture looks consistent across pillars and walls
Confirm the drop shadows on text are subtle and natural
recipe.reuseFormula: Architectural Portrait + Chiseled Display Type + Earth Tone Palette + Textured Negative Space
